items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: This is my uncle. That's my aunt's husband.

ctx.x: Well, Willi was way behind me though, you know. Oh, yeah. Little Willi. Sure, little. I was a big Willi.
He's got ten years on you though. It's ten after five. This is my uncle. That's my aunt's husband.
How do you do? Good to know you. I'm Mr. Monetta, Professor Monetta, Mr. Thompson. All right, Mr. Thompson.
